definition.name: feature
definition.for_requests: adding or changing something a person uses

steps.label: Propose
steps.instructions: Ask what is unclear, one question at a time. Then put one proposal to the person: a plan, with a sketch inside it if a picture helps, or a sketch, a draft, a document or a rough walk alone. Prefer one. Wait for the person to approve it. After an approved card that was not a plan, record the tasks at once: the person is not asked again.

steps.label: Walk
steps.instructions: Build the mock in the real Bridge on fixtures and show it as a walk, or several where the change has several places. Write no tests until the person approves every walk you showed. Notes come back as another take.

steps.label: Refine
steps.instructions: Wire it to the real thing and write the tests now. Show a new walk only if the look changed.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.instructions: Open the pull request and merge it on a green ci. Say what landed.

definition.name: bug
definition.for_requests: something that worked and no longer does

steps.label: Find the cause
steps.instructions: Reproduce the bug. Find why it happens, not only where it shows. Say the cause in a line.

steps.label: Fix
steps.instructions: Make the smallest change that addresses the cause. Write no tests yet. Then show the fix as a short walk straight to the place.

steps.label: Tests
steps.instructions: Write a test that fails without the fix and passes with it.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.instructions: Open the pull request and merge it on a green ci. Say what landed.

definition.name: design_plan
definition.for_requests: a design to settle before anything is built

steps.label: Propose

After an approved card that was not a plan, record the tasks at once: the person is not asked again.

steps.label: Sketch
steps.instructions: Show the options as sketches, one idea each. Build nothing.

steps.label: Record plan
steps.instructions: Record what was chosen and what it leaves out. Wait for approval.
